description: Drill-down view for a single search term (sanatizedTerm). Reached from the term tables on the Search Insights dashboard. Type a term in the variable to inspect any term ad-hoc.

panels.description: Total searches that match the selected term in the time range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total
FROM sn_site_metric_access m
JOIN sn_site s ON s.id = m.sn_site_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(m.`accessDate`)
  AND m.`sanatizedTerm` = '$term'
  AND ('$site' = 'All' OR s.`name` = '$site')

panels.title: Searches for '$term'

panels.description: Distinct users (or anonymous buckets) who searched this term.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(m.`userId`, ''), CONCAT('anon-', m.id))) AS users
FROM sn_site_metric_access m
JOIN sn_site s ON s.id = m.sn_site_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(m.`accessDate`)
  AND m.`sanatizedTerm` = '$term'
  AND ('$site' = 'All' OR s.`name` = '$site')

panels.title: Distinct users

panels.description: Average number of results returned for this term — high values mean common (possibly too generic), low values mean specific or content-gap.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(m.`numFound`), 1) AS avg_results
FROM sn_site_metric_access m
JOIN sn_site s ON s.id = m.sn_site_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(m.`accessDate`)
  AND m.`sanatizedTerm` = '$term'
  AND ('$site' = 'All' OR s.`name` = '$site')

panels.title: Avg results returned

panels.description: Share of searches for this term that came back empty. Strong signal for content prioritisation when both this and total volume are high.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN m.`numFound` = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS zero_rate
FROM sn_site_metric_access m
JOIN sn_site s ON s.id = m.sn_site_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(m.`accessDate`)
  AND m.`sanatizedTerm` = '$term'
  AND ('$site' = 'All' OR s.`name` = '$site')

panels.title: Zero-result rate for term

panels.description: How searches for this term are distributed over time. Spikes correlate with campaigns, news, or seasonal interest.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroup(m.`accessDate`, $__interval) AS time,
  CASE WHEN m.`numFound` = 0 THEN 'no results' ELSE 'with results' END AS metric,
  COUNT(*) AS value
FROM sn_site_metric_access m
JOIN sn_site s ON s.id = m.sn_site_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(m.`accessDate`)
  AND m.`sanatizedTerm` = '$term'
  AND ('$site' = 'All' OR s.`name` = '$site')
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Searches over time for '$term'

panels.description: Which sites the term appears on. A term that's hot on one site but absent from another can indicate cross-promotion or facet-mapping opportunities.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.`name` AS site, COUNT(*) AS searches
FROM sn_site_metric_access m
JOIN sn_site s ON s.id = m.sn_site_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(m.`accessDate`)
  AND m.`sanatizedTerm` = '$term'
GROUP BY s.`name`
ORDER BY searches DESC

panels.title: Sites where '$term' was searched

panels.description: Languages used to search for this term. May reveal that the term is searched mostly in a specific locale even on multilingual sites.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(m.`language`, ''), 'unknown') AS lang, COUNT(*) AS searches
FROM sn_site_metric_access m
JOIN sn_site s ON s.id = m.sn_site_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(m.`accessDate`)
  AND m.`sanatizedTerm` = '$term'
  AND ('$site' = 'All' OR s.`name` = '$site')
GROUP BY m.`language`
ORDER BY searches DESC

panels.title: Languages

panels.description: Distribution of result-set sizes specifically for this term. Useful to see if a term oscillates between zero and many results (catalog churn) or is consistently bad.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT bucket, searches FROM (
  SELECT '0 (zero)' AS bucket, 1 AS ord, COUNT(*) AS searches FROM sn_site_metric_access m JOIN sn_site s ON s.id = m.sn_site_id WHERE $__timeFilter(m.`accessDate`) AND m.`sanatizedTerm` = '$term' AND ('$site' = 'All' OR s.`name` = '$site') AND m.`numFound` = 0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '1' AS bucket, 2 AS ord, COUNT(*) FROM sn_site_metric_access m JOIN sn_site s ON s.id = m.sn_site_id WHERE $__timeFilter(m.`accessDate`) AND m.`sanatizedTerm` = '$term' AND ('$site' = 'All' OR s.`name` = '$site') AND m.`numFound` = 1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '2-10' AS bucket, 3 AS ord, COUNT(*) FROM sn_site_metric_access m JOIN sn_site s ON s.id = m.sn_site_id WHERE $__timeFilter(m.`accessDate`) AND m.`sanatizedTerm` = '$term' AND ('$site' = 'All' OR s.`name` = '$site') AND m.`numFound` BETWEEN 2 AND 10
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '11-100' AS bucket, 4 AS ord, COUNT(*) FROM sn_site_metric_access m JOIN sn_site s ON s.id = m.sn_site_id WHERE $__timeFilter(m.`accessDate`) AND m.`sanatizedTerm` = '$term' AND ('$site' = 'All' OR s.`name` = '$site') AND m.`numFound` BETWEEN 11 AND 100
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '100+' AS bucket, 5 AS ord, COUNT(*) FROM sn_site_metric_access m JOIN sn_site s ON s.id = m.sn_site_id WHERE $__timeFilter(m.`accessDate`) AND m.`sanatizedTerm` = '$term' AND ('$site' = 'All' OR s.`name` = '$site') AND m.`numFound` > 100
) t
ORDER BY ord

panels.title: Result-size distribution for '$term'

panels.description: Other terms searched by users who also searched for this term, in the same time window. A simple co-occurrence proxy — useful for synonym discovery and 'related searches' suggestions.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  other.`sanatizedTerm` AS related_term,
  COUNT(DISTINCT other.`userId`) AS shared_users,
  COUNT(*) AS co_searches
FROM sn_site_metric_access seed
JOIN sn_site_metric_access other
  ON other.`userId` = seed.`userId`
  AND other.`userId` IS NOT NULL
  AND other.`userId` <> ''
  AND other.`sanatizedTerm` <> seed.`sanatizedTerm`
  AND other.`sanatizedTerm` IS NOT NULL
  AND other.`sanatizedTerm` <> ''
JOIN sn_site s ON s.id = seed.sn_site_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(seed.`accessDate`)
  AND $__timeFilter(other.`accessDate`)
  AND seed.`sanatizedTerm` = '$term'
  AND ('$site' = 'All' OR s.`name` = '$site')
GROUP BY other.`sanatizedTerm`
ORDER BY shared_users DESC, co_searches DESC
LIMIT 15

panels.title: Related terms (co-searched by same users)

panels.description: Most recent searches for this term — useful as forensic evidence (when did the spike start, who was involved).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  m.`accessDate`,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(m.`userId`, ''), 'anonymous') AS user,
  s.`name` AS site,
  m.`language` AS lang,
  m.`numFound`,
  m.`term` AS raw_term
FROM sn_site_metric_access m
JOIN sn_site s ON s.id = m.sn_site_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(m.`accessDate`)
  AND m.`sanatizedTerm` = '$term'
  AND ('$site' = 'All' OR s.`name` = '$site')
ORDER BY m.`accessDate` DESC
LIMIT 100
